reason: No unambiguous, widely-agreed public definition exists for a chart "ladder" pattern (unlike VCP/flag/channel/cup-and-handle, which at least have multiple independently-published parameterizations to choose among). Coding it would require inventing the rule set from scratch, which is fabrication dressed as pattern-recognition, not testing an established technical concept. Declined outright rather than inventing a definition and presenting it as if it were a known, testable pattern.
resurrection_condition: A specific, citable, pre-existing published definition of this pattern (source + exact rules) would need to be supplied before this could be coded and tested.
